title: quercus pubescens var. iberica
intro: Quercus pubescens var. iberica, commonly known as the Iberian downy oak, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the Quercus genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus pubescens var. iberica are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
